lines.empty: No lines yet. Add the first one.

availability.cannotProduce: Cannot fully produce: material is missing

availability.stale: The lines changed after this check. Check again.
availability.error: Could not check the availability. Try again.

sheet.unsavedDescription: Your changes have not been saved.

validation.maxLength: This is too long. Please shorten it.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.INVALID_STATUS: This is not possible in the current status. Reload the document.
errors.ALREADY_LINKED: A sale order already exists for this quotation.
errors.NOTHING_TO_DELIVER: Everything is already on a delivery note.
errors.IN_USE: A sale order uses this document, so it cannot be changed.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.

send.title: Send this quotation?
send.description: The quotation is recorded as sent to the customer. The system does not send an e-mail. It can no longer be edited.

accept.title: Mark as accepted?
accept.description: The customer agreed to this quotation. You can then create a sale order from it.

reject.title: Mark as rejected?
reject.description: The customer did not accept this quotation. Say why; it is kept in the history.

expire.title: Mark as expired?
expire.description: The customer did not answer in time. The quotation can no longer be accepted.

create-order.title: Create a sale order?
create-order.description: A draft sale order is made with the customer and lines of this quotation. You can still change it.

request-confirm.title: Ask a Manager to confirm?
request-confirm.description: A Sale Manager will see the request and confirm or reject the order. You cannot edit it while it waits.

approve.title: Confirm this sale order?
approve.description: The order is accepted by Sale and can be sent to the factory. It can no longer be edited.

reject-confirm.title: Reject the confirmation?
reject-confirm.description: The order goes back to the requester to change. Say what needs to change.

send-to-factory.title: Send to the factory?
send-to-factory.description: The production request is recorded and the order moves to In production.

mark-ready.title: Mark as ready to deliver?
mark-ready.description: The finished goods are ready. You can then create delivery notes.

create-delivery-note.title: Create a delivery note?
create-delivery-note.description: A draft delivery note is made with the quantities that are not on a note yet.

close.title: Close this order?
close.description: The order is finished. Only a Manager can reopen it by reverting.

cancel.title: Cancel this order?
cancel.description: The order is stopped and nothing more can be done with it. Say why if you can; it is kept in the history.

confirm.title: Confirm the delivery?
confirm.description: The goods have been delivered to the customer. The note can no longer be edited. When everything is delivered the order becomes Delivered.

revert.title: Revert to the previous status?
revert.description: Use this to correct a wrong click. The reason is kept in the history.

quotations.pastValidUntil: The valid-until date has passed. Mark the quotation as expired, or accept it if the customer agreed.
